newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Taiwan buys Jan 1-20 fuel oil at around $143/T.
newsitem.headline: Taiwan buys Jan 1-20 fuel oil at around $143/T.

text.p: Taiwan's state-owned Chinese Petroleum Corp (CPC) has bought by tender 38,000 tonnes of January low sulphur fuel oil at $143 per tonne, traders said on Thursday.
The 0.5-percent sulphur high viscosity fuel oil is for delivery between January 1-20 to Keelung, Shen Ao or Taichung.
While CPC official could not comment on the seller, traders in Singapore said market talks was that a Japanese trading house has won the the tender.
In its previous tender, CPC purchased a low sulphur fuel oil cargo for delivery November 21 to December 20 at low $140s.
